title: Public-Seed Ideal Cipher Construction from a Random Permutation
summary: Existing generic indifferentiable constructions do not cover the public-seed setting, leaving open whether a random permutation generically suffices to realize an ideal cipher.

formal_statement.body: In the public-seed setting, determine whether an ideal cipher can be constructed generically and indifferentiably from a random permutation. The question remains unresolved because generic indifferentiable constructions of ideal ciphers from random permutations do not apply in this setting.

scope.domain: Design of cryptographic primitives involving generic indifferentiable constructions of ideal ciphers from random permutations in the public-seed setting.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether an ideal cipher can be constructed generically and indifferentiably from a random permutation in the public-seed setting, since existing generic constructions do not apply there.

progress.summary: The source presents this as an unresolved generic converse concerning the public-seed setting. It notes that existing indifferentiable constructions of ideal ciphers from random permutations do not apply there.
citation_labels: Pratik Soni et al., Public-Seed Pseudorandom Permutations
